spatial_control: All temporal arms evaluated on identical frozen Source boxes AND identical frozen Full boxes. Neither comparison re-decodes space. E3 main causal table uses Source boxes. These isolate temporal decisions; they are not reconfigured end-to-end pipelines.

definitions.P0Native: FP32 per-offset native MAP endpoints then physical hull; original Source boxes. Distinct from Source published MBR.
definitions.P0MBR: Sealed exact physical-hull native prior + original MBR; exact existing Source interval.
definitions.P0MAP: Joint physical-hull prior MAP; NOT per-offset native hull.
definitions.Soft: Original ONE round kappa64 beta1 all-video soft pair + MBR; exact Full temporal output.
definitions.P1MAP: Same Soft posterior, joint physical MAP.
definitions.Hard: ONE pair from hard membership of P0MBR interval; kappa64; native final prior.
definitions.EventOnly: Log positive compatibility alone; no background denominator. Raw length bias retained.
definitions.EventCentered: EventOnly minus video mean, predeclared length-bias control; never promote by outcome.
definitions.UniformPrior: Same second-stage Soft evidence, uniform on original positive support as final prior; native seed remains.

statistics: Equal query. Paired parent-cluster 10000 bootstrap seed20261024. All signed, time groups <=5sec, severe decline>5pp t/v/union once, offline frame AUROC/evidence distribution and native coverage. No setting selection or production promotion; both full sets previously examined.
stages: All12205 prediction records seal before independent CPU scorer. Domain jobs parallel CPU only. New support features and first-DP controls in independent collector stage.
